verdict.rationale: Polar documents its own billing processes that run unattended in the background once configured. Subscriptions renew automatically each period, failed payments enter an automated dunning flow with scheduled retries and customer emails, and seats can be added, removed and prorated automatically. These are fixed, built-in billing behaviors rather than general automations the user designs, and webhooks are only building blocks for automations the user would build elsewhere. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers, schedules and actions, agent-driven background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
